title: [clinic · EX-22] Fix evidence retention
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-22` — Fix evidence retention](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-22-fix-evidence-retention.md) · difficulty ⚫

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Raising `k` and calling it fixed. It works, at 93% more tokens and a collapse in `context_precision` — see [#28](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/discussions/28).

**2.** Applying a coverage constraint globally. It helps `comparison` questions and hurts single-hop ones; it has to be conditional and that has to be shown.

**3.** Measuring only `full_chain_recall`. The constraint can improve it while damaging precision, and both belong in the report.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-22]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
